INTERNAL makes AccessControlPermission skip access-level checks. A read-only project member can therefore create, edit, restore, or delete brief configurations; the same setting on ProductBriefViewSet also lets them trigger billable generation. Use a scope that enforces project write access for mutating actions, or add an explicit permission that distinguishes reads from writes.

author: veria-ai
body:
Medium: Brief generation lacks AI abuse controls
The default API throttles do not limit authenticated session requests, and each newly created config produces a distinct workflow ID. An abusive or compromised member can create fresh configs and enqueue parallel workflows, each running up to 100 insight calculations followed by a billable LLM request. Apply the existing AI burst and sustained throttles to this action and enforce a team-level concurrency or generation limit that cannot be bypassed with new config IDs.
